evidence: Carries the P2P label and modifies connection management and peer transport in src/net.cpp and src/net_processing.cpp.
rationale: Adds the `-v2onlyclearnet` option to enforce encrypted v2 P2P transport on IPv4 and IPv6, preventing passive network eavesdropping. Users previously could not prevent cleartext v1 connections or downgrade reconnections without disabling clearnet entirely, and review discussion confirms this meaningfully raises tampering and snooping costs against ISP inspection.
